title: COMMAND THE FIRST SUNDAY OF THE NEW MONTH
text: Father God, we come before your throne right now. We come in the authority of the blood of Jesus Christ. We come as the redeemed of the Lord, as kings and priests onto our God. Every demon that thought it has a say in this month, your authority is broken. Every witchcraft power that has assembled against this season, scatter by fire. We speak to the heavens and command the angelic hosts to take their positions. Let the hosts of God arise. Let the watchers of the almighty go forth. In Jesus' name, we declare it. Someone is hearing this right now, and the spirit of God is saying to you, this month is not for compromise. This month is not for sitting on the fence. This month is not for the timid or the fearful. Listen carefully to what I'm about to minister to you, because I believe God is going to use this word to reposition your entire year. When you share this message with someone else, God might use you as a vessel to birth a prophecy in their life that will cause their family, their marriage, their business, their ministry to transform. Don't just listen, become a carrier of this word. Now, I want you to go with me to Deuteronomy 28 and verse 1. And it shall come to pass, if thou shall hearken diligently onto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth. Do you see what Moses is establishing here? There are dimensions to this scripture that the church has not yet fully grasped. When you move into a new month, listen carefully, you are not just moving into 30 or 31 days. You are moving into a portal, a threshold, where God has positioned his people to exercise dominion. The first Sunday of the month is not accidental. It is not arbitrary. It is a divine appointment. It is a juncture where you stand at the gates and declare the will of God for the entire season ahead. And I hear the spirit of the Lord saying this morning, command it. Take authority. Speak to those gates because what you decree in the spirit realm, the natural realm must obey. What you establish through prayer and declaration, heaven will back up. This is not presumption. This is not false confidence. This is apostolic authority operating in the body of Christ. Let me take you to Joshua chapter 1, verses 8 and 9. This book of the Lord shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success. Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage. Be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed, for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest. Notice the language of God to Joshua. Have not I commanded thee? God is not asking Joshua to beg. God is not asking Joshua to hope. God is asking Joshua to operate from a place of command, command that is rooted in obedience, command that is rooted in alignment with the divine will. And now, in this new month, every believer reading this has the same authority that Joshua had, the same God, the same power, the same spirit. But there is something else the spirit of God wants to deposit in your spirit right now. There are forces, dark forces that have been assembled against you. There are altars that have been erected in the realm of the spirit speaking against your promotion. There are covenants of darkness that have been made over your family, and they're saying, "Not this year. Not in this month. Not while we have breath. But I decree and declare this morning every altar speaking against your progress is consumed with fire. Every principality that has stationed itself over your finances, I strip your authority. Every familiar spirit that has followed your family line for seven generations, your dominion ends today. By the power of the blood of Jesus Christ, by the authority given to us as sons and daughters of the most high God, we command you release your hold. Do you know what the enemy fears most? The enemy does not fear your declaration when it is born out of emotion. The enemy does not fear your prayers when they are born out of desperation alone. But when a believer, a blood washed, spirit filled, authority conscious believer stands and commands in alignment with the word and will of God, the heavens respond, the earth trembles, demons flee. This is why Ephesians 6:10-12 must become more than a scripture to you. It must become a reality. Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. Put on the whole armor of God that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Listen, flesh and blood is not your problem. Your boss is not your problem. Your circumstances are not your problem. Your past is not your problem. The problem is the spiritual infrastructure that has been built to keep you trapped, to keep you limited, to keep you from entering into the fullness of God's purpose for your life. And the good news, the absolutely wonderful news is that this new month is the month where you dismantle that infrastructure. I want to tell you something that the spirit is speaking to my heart. There are women under the sound of my voice who have been waiting for a breakthrough in their womb. The doctor said it is not possible. Your family said you should accept your fate, but God is breaking that word over your life right now. I speak to the reproductive system of every woman who is believing God for a child, be opened, be fruitful. Receive the blessing of the Lord. Your womb is not dead. Your womb is not barren. It is a portal of blessing, and the Lord is opening it in this season. And I see someone, a man who has been struggling with chains of lust, chains of adultery, chains of pornography. The spirit of God is saying to you today, the power of that addiction is broken. You will not die in that prison. This month, I decree your deliverance. Your wife does not have to know about your secret anymore. You will come clean. You will get help. You will stand in accountability, and the Lord will heal your marriage and make you whole. Let me continue in 2 Corinthians 10, verses 3 through 5. For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh. For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds, casting down imaginations and every high thing that exalted itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. Do you understand what Paul is teaching here? Your weapons are not guns. Your weapons are not arguments. Your weapons are not the things that the world uses. Your weapons are spiritual. Your prayers are weapons. Your declarations are weapons. Your worship is a weapon. Your obedience is a weapon. And when you take these weapons, when you walk in understanding of what you possess, you can pull down strongholds that have stood for decades. There is someone in a city, I think it is Lagos, I think it is Abuja, I think it is Port Harcourt. The Lord is speaking to me about a woman named Zainab or Zeinab. Your name is coming to me. The Lord says he has noticed your pain. He has seen the rejection you have suffered. He has watched how people have looked at your family and made judgments. But the spirit of the almighty is saying your season is over. The shame of your house is finished. From this month forward, you will walk in dignity, you will walk in honor, you will walk in the blessing of the Lord. Prepare yourself for doors that are about to open. I also want to speak to the finances of God's people. I hear the spirit saying the embargo on your finance is broken. Hear me clearly. There are people who have been working working hard, but there has been a spiritual embargo over their increase. There has been a witchcraft gate standing against the multiplication of their resources. There have been principalities assigned to intercept your blessings before they reach your hand, but not anymore. I decree and declare every satanic gate that stands between you and your increase fall down. Every demon assigned to delay your promotion, you are fired. Every cause of poverty, every word spoken against your prosperity, every covenant made in darkness to keep you broken and broken, I cancel you by the power of the blood of Jesus. And I speak to the business owners. I speak to the entrepreneurs. I speak to the employees who are believing for advancement. The Lord is opening doors this month. Not maybe, not probably, certainly. The Lord says he will give you wisdom. He will give you favor with man. He will give you the courage to step into assignments that previously felt impossible. Your increase is not dependent on the economy. Your increase is not dependent on your bosses mood. Your increase is dependent on the covenant you have made with the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and that covenant cannot be broken. Now, I want to enter deeper into the realm of prayer because this is where the power becomes manifest. This is where you move from declaration to transformation. This is where heaven and earth intersect. I want everyone listening to me to place their hand on their chest right now. Feel your heartbeat. That heartbeat is a testimony that God has not finished with you. That breath you are drawing is evidence that your destiny is not complete. And I want to invite you into a place of war prayer, aggressive, focused, fierce prayer that shifts the spiritual atmosphere. Let's pray. Almighty God, Father of all nations, we come before you with reverence, but we come with authority. We come as the blood washed, spirit filled army of the most high. And I want to speak first to the issue of destiny. There are people whose destinies have been hijacked. The enemy has attempted to intercept the plan of God for their lives. But I pray right now Psalm 27:2, "When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell." I speak to every demon that has come to divorce someone's destiny. You will stumble. You will fall. You will not succeed. Every witch doctor's incantation spoken against someone's future, I nullify it. Every hex, every curse, every evil eye, by the blood of Jesus, it is broken. And Lord, I pray for the families. How many families in this nation are suffering? How many homes are divided? How many children are growing up without the blessing of a father or the security of a mother's love? But the God of restoration is alive. The God of reconciliation is near. I speak to every fractured family relationship. I speak to estrangement. I speak to betrayal within family lines. Lord God, heal these relationships. Break the generational trauma. Break the cycles of abuse, of abandonment, of disappointment. Let fathers step into their roles. Let mothers embrace their calling. Let siblings reconcile. Let cousins reconnect. Let the blood of Jesus wash away the bitterness, the resentment, the unforgiveness that has festered for years. And there is someone, and I see this clearly, there is a mother and her son who have not spoken in years. The separation between them is breaking my heart as I pray. But the spirit of God says, "This is the month of restoration. Go and reconcile. Make that phone call. Knock on that door. Swallow your pride and let love win again. Because what the enemy meant for evil to separate you forever, God intends to turn into good." Now, I want to speak about the marriages. Lord, how many marriages are in crisis? How many couples have allowed the stress of life, the pressure of work, the toxicity of unforgiveness to poison what was meant to be holy? But marriage is not just an institution, it is a covenant. It is a picture of Christ and the church. And I pray right now for every marriage that is hanging by a thread. Father, restore love where love has grown cold. Restore communication where silence has become the language. Restore intimacy where distance has settled in. Break the power of pornography, adultery, and betrayal that has infiltrated these marriages. Restore the passion, the fire, the tenderness that was there in the beginning. And I speak to the singles who are waiting. Don't give up. Don't settle. Don't compromise your standards because you are tired of waiting. The Lord is preparing someone for you. The Lord is ordering your steps. And in this month, I declare that the weight is ending. Not just any person, the right person. The person who is aligned with your purpose, your vision, your faith, and your values. Prepare yourself because preparation precedes presentation. Now I move to the realm of health and healing. I have the authority given to me by Jesus Christ himself to speak to sickness, to disease, to infirmity. The scripture says in Matthew 8:17 that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet saying, "Himself took our infirmities and bear our sicknesses." And so I speak right now to every pain that is lodged in someone's body. I speak to cancer. I speak to diabetes. I speak to hypertension. I speak to the chronic illness that has been diagnosed as incurable. No disease is permanent when the God of resurrection is involved. I command every cell in your body to obey the word of God. I command inflammation to decrease. I command the immune system to be strengthened. I command the doctors to be amazed at your recovery. This is not witchcraft. This is not mind over matter. This is the authority of Jesus Christ flowing through a believer who understands their position in him. There is someone specifically I see a woman with a fibroid condition. The medical report says it is too large for removal, but the Lord says, "I am removing it from you. Not surgery. I am dissolving it by my power. You will go back to your doctor and there will be no trace of it." And I speak to the men. There are men struggling with sexual dysfunction, with prostate issues, with infertility, but your manhood is not determined by your body's performance. Your manhood is determined by your relationship with God. And I declare your body is being healed, your vigor is being restored, your confidence is being rebuilt. Now, let me address the issues of witchcraft, curses, and demonic covenants directly, because this is serious business and the church must understand that this is real. There are forces of darkness that have been loosed against the people of God. There are witches, yes, actual witches who have made it their assignment to steal, kill, and destroy the anointed of God. There are ancestral curses that have been speaking over family lines for generations. There are evil altars that have been erected in the spirit realm, and satanic priests are praying day and night speaking against your breakthrough. But listen to me, we do not fear them, we do not run from them, we do not negotiate with them, we command them. I decree right now every witch that has you in their target, I blind their eyes. Every spell that has been cast against you, I reverse it. Every witchcraft covenant made over your head, I tear it to shreds. By the authority of the name of Jesus, by the power of his resurrection, by the authority of his blood, I command every demon of witchcraft to loose your people and depart. And I speak to the generational curses. Listen to Deuteronomy 28 verses 15 through 19. But it shall come to pass if thou will not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I commanded this day, that all these curses shall come upon thee and overtake thee. Now, these curses were conditional. They came because of disobedience, but when you repent, when you turn from the old ways, when you align yourself with the word and will of God, the curse is broken. And so, I break every curse of failure that has spoken over your family. I break every curse of sickness. I break every curse of infertility. I break every curse of poverty. I break every curse of untimely death. In the name of Jesus Christ, you are free. Now, I want to speak about something that the spirit is really emphasizing right now, the restoration of time and virtue. There are people who have lost years to sin. There are people who have lost their reputation. There are people who are walking in shame because of what happened in their past. But Joel 2:25 says this, "And I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you." Listen, God is not just going to forgive you. God is not just going to overlook what happened. God is going to restore to you what was stolen. The time, the opportunity, the relationships, the advancement, the reputation, God is going to restore it. I see someone who made a terrible mistake years ago. You compromise your integrity. You betrayed someone's trust. You walked away from your calling. And you have been living with the weight of that regret ever since. But God is saying to you, "I am giving you a second chance. I am restoring your name. I am opening a new door. Walk into it with confidence, knowing that you have been forgiven, redeemed, and restored." Now, I want to speak about the power of the Holy Spirit and angelic intervention because prayer is not just you talking to God. Prayer activates heaven. Prayer releases the hosts of God. Prayer commands the angels to move on your behalf. Psalm 91:11-12 say, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone." And so I pray, let the angelic hosts of the almighty be released on behalf of God's people. Let Michael the archangel stand as a warrior on behalf of those who are being opposed in the spirit. Let Gabriel bring messages of encouragement to those who are discouraged. Let the angels go forth and gather up every blessing that heaven has prepared and bring it to the hands of those who are believing. I speak to the protection of God's people. There are assignments of death against believers. There are plots in darkness to take lives, to cause accidents, to bring destruction. But I declare no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Every death trap is exposed. Every assassination attempt is thwarted. Every plan of destruction is reversed. Someone is hearing this and you know there was a close call in traffic. You know there was a moment when something terrible could have happened but it didn't. That was not luck. That was not coincidence. That was the hand of God. That was the angels of God intervening. And I want you to understand, God is not finished protecting you. He will continue to preserve your life. Now let me speak directly about this first Sunday of the new month, the theme of our ministry, because this Sunday is a threshold. This is a moment of cosmic significance. When you command on the first Sunday, you are essentially setting the spiritual atmosphere for the entire month. You are declaring what will and will not be permitted in your life, your family, your finances, your health, and your destiny for the next 30 days. And I want you to understand something that the spirit is strongly emphasizing the words you speak this morning matter. The declarations you make have power. The prayers you pray have weight. They are not hollow, they are not powerless, they are creative. They carry the force of God almighty. In Genesis 1, we see God speaking things into existence. God said, "Let there be light." And light appeared. And we, as beings made in the image of God, we have been given the same creative power of speech. But most believers are using their words carelessly. They are speaking death. They are speaking limitation. They are speaking fear. They are speaking defeat. And they are creating the very reality they are afraid of. But not anymore. This month, you will speak with intention. You will speak with power. You will speak life, blessing, favor, promotion, healing, and restoration. And the universe, the entire spiritual and natural order will align with what you have spoken. I command someone right now. Stop speaking defeat over your life. Stop saying, "I can't." Stop saying, "It is too late." Stop saying, "It is impossible." Start saying, "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me." Start saying, "My God will supply all my needs." Start saying, "I am the head, not the tail. I am above, not beneath." Let me speak to those in ministry, those who are pastors, prophets, evangelists, teachers, and apostles. This month is crucial for you. There is a mantle that is shifting. There are assignments that are being released. The Lord is saying it is time to be bold. It is time to speak my word without compromise. It is time to call sin sin. It is time to call righteousness righteousness. It is time to stand against the moral erosion in the church. I decree that every true minister of God will walk in boldness this month. You will not be intimidated by opposition. You will not be swayed by criticism. You will not dilute the message to make people comfortable. You will be faithful to God and to his word. And for those who are struggling with the anointing, those who feel that their gifting has dried up, that they have lost their effectiveness, the spirit of God is saying, "I am refreshing you. I am renewing your anointing. I am giving you fresh fire. The season of your diminishing is over. The season of your increase begins now." There is a pastor somewhere who has been discouraged. The growth of your church has plateaued. Finances have been tight. People have left and gone to other churches. And you have been questioning whether you are still called, but the spirit is saying you are not finished. Your greatest days are ahead. I am about to do something in your ministry that will astound you. And I want to speak about the power of your words in commanding this month. You are not just speaking to the natural realm. You are speaking into the spiritual realm. Every declaration you make is being recorded in heaven. Every prayer is being registered before the throne of God. And God is dispatching angels and resources to bring your spoken word into manifestation. So, speak with conviction. Speak with faith. Speak with the authority that you have in Christ Jesus. I decree this month, my business will experience unprecedented growth. I decree this month, my finances will increase. I decree this month, my relationships will be healed. I decree this month, my body will be made whole. I decree this month, my family will walk in blessing. I decree this month, my enemies will be confused and turned back. I decree this month, I will step into a new level of favor and promotion. Now, I want to take you to a scripture that I believe encapsulates the power of what we are doing right now. Luke 10:19 and 20. Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you. Notwithstanding in this, rejoice not that the spirits are subject unto you, but rather rejoice because your names are written in heaven. Jesus is saying to you, I have given you authority. I have armed you with power. Everything that comes against you, you have the right and the ability to crush it under your feet. But here is the key. Do not get so caught up in worrying with demons that you forget the greatest blessing, your name is written in the book of life. So yes, we pray against the enemy. Yes, we command and declare. Yes, we take authority, but our ultimate joy is not in the defeat of the enemy. Our ultimate joy is in our relationship with God, in our eternal security, in the fact that we belong to him. Someone is hearing this message and the spirit of the almighty is speaking directly to your spirit right now. And he's saying, I love you. I have never stopped loving you. In the midst of your struggle, I have been with you. In the midst of your failure, I have not abandoned you. In the midst of your pain, I have been counting your tears. And this month, I am doing something new. This month, I am healing you. This month, I am restoring you. This month, I am elevating you. Will you believe it? Will you command it? Will you declare it into the spirit realm? Now, let me close with the power of this moment because what we are doing right now is not just a service. This is warfare. This is intercession. This is the body of Christ exercising the authority that has been given to us. And I want to make declarations on behalf of everyone under the sound of my voice. I decree the siege over your life is broken. Every spiritual blockade is lifted. Every demonic stronghold is dismantled. The way is clear for you to step into your blessing. I decree your enemies will see what God is about to do in your life and they will be silenced. Your breakthrough will be so obvious, so undeniable that even those who have opposed you will have to acknowledge the hand of God on your life. I decree this month is the month of transition. Some of you are moving from one place to another. Some of you are moving from one assignment to another. Some of you are moving from poverty to prosperity. Some of you are moving from sickness to health. Some of you are moving from loneliness to community. God is moving you and I declare that the move will be peaceful, prosperous, and purposeful. I decree the integrity of your life will be restored. People will look at you and see the change. They will ask what happened to you and you will say God happened to me. I decree your children will rise up and call you blessed. Your legacy will be one of faith, of integrity, of faithfulness to God and generations to come will reap the benefits of the choices you are making right now. I speak to the youth. Some of you are standing at a crossroads. You do not know which path to take, but the spirit of the almighty is saying follow me. Seek first the kingdom of God and all these things will be added on to you. Do not chase the temporary pleasures of this world. Chase the eternal purposes of God, and I declare that your life will be extraordinary. Your impact will be significant. You will be a voice for God in your generation, and I want to release something into the spirit right now. I want to speak in the language of the spirit. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. We give you glory, oh God. We give you honor, oh God. We magnify your name. We celebrate your power. We rejoice in your faithfulness. You are worthy. You are holy. You are just. You are merciful. You are mighty. You are strong. You are tender. You are the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You are the God of the covenant. You are the God who keeps his word. You are the God who is faithful even when we are faithless. Hallelujah. We come before your throne this morning, and we acknowledge you are the Lord. You are God. You are righteous. Your ways are perfect. Your timing is perfect. Your word is perfect. And we submit ourselves to you. We yield to you. We surrender to you. And as we walk into this new month, we do so with confidence. We do so with authority. We do so knowing that the battle has already been won by the blood of Jesus Christ. The victory belongs to us. The triumph belongs to us. The blessing belongs to us. And so I decree walk into this month with your head held high. Walk as more than a conqueror. Walk as royalty. Walk as the beloved of God. Walk knowing that nothing can separate you from the love of God. Walk knowing that no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Walk knowing that your God is with you, before you, behind you, and around you. The siege is broken. The captives are free. The bound are loose. The sick are healed. The dead are raised, the lost are found, the broken are mended, the weak are strengthened, the discouraged are encouraged, the hopeless are given hope, and all of this happens through the power, the name, the blood, and the authority of Jesus Christ. I declare this week is your testimony. This week is the beginning of your breakthrough. This week is a threshold into a new season. This week is when heaven touches earth on your behalf. This week is when God shows up and shows out for you. And as we close this ministry time, I want everyone to take a moment of silence. In that silence, you are going to speak directly to God. You are going to command your month. You are going to declare what you want God to do. You are going to take authority over your life, and God is going to hear you. God is going to respond. God is going to move. Do it now. Speak it. Command it. Declare it. Believe it. Your blessing is coming. Your healing is coming. Your promotion is coming. Your restoration is coming. Your victory is coming in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, in the power of his blood, in the authority of his resurrection. I declare it. Amen. Amen. Amen.
